methodology: Normalized and architecture-grounded threat dataset evaluated for Master's thesis benchmarking.

metrics.reference_coverage: Not calculated (independent reference set not supplied)

threats.threat_description: Broken Object-Level Authorization (BOLA/IDOR): Attacker supplies an unauthorized file ID in DF5, and P2 fails to enforce ownership checks against DS2, enabling unauthorized file access.
threats.attack_preconditions: Authenticated user submits a request for a file identifier belonging to another user.
threats.security_impact: Unauthorized read access to confidential documents belonging to other users.
threats.architecture_evidence: P2 is the primary enforcement point for file authorization and must verify user ownership against DS2 before querying DS1.
threats.mitigation: Enforce mandatory, fail-closed authorization checks associating user ID, object ID, and action against DS2 on every access request.
threats.cvss_rationale: Network vector, low complexity, requires low privileges, High Confidentiality and Integrity impact.
threats.reviewer_validation_basis: Audited against architecture: P2 enforces object-level access control using DS2 permission records.

threats.data_flow_ref: DF2: Uploaded File + Metadata / DF3: Validated File Storage Request
threats.mitre_attack: T1059: Command and Scripting Interpreter (Path Traversal)
threats.owasp_top_10_2025: A01:2021 - Broken Access Control / Path Traversal
threats.threat_description: Path traversal or filename manipulation during upload validation (DF2) allows an attacker to overwrite sensitive files or write outside designated storage directories in DS1.
threats.attack_preconditions: Attacker supplies malicious path characters (e.g., `../../`) in upload metadata.
threats.security_impact: Arbitrary file overwrite, storage corruption, and potential code execution.
threats.architecture_evidence: P2 receives user-provided filenames and metadata across TB1 and writes validated files to DS1.
threats.mitigation: Sanitize user-supplied filenames, generate server-managed random UUIDs for storage keys, and validate extensions/MIME types.
threats.cvss_rationale: Network vector, low complexity, requires low privileges, High impact across C, I, and A.
threats.reviewer_validation_basis: Audited against architecture: P2 validates user-supplied metadata before persisting objects to DS1.

threats.data_flow_ref: DF1: File Upload Request / DF2: Uploaded File + Metadata
threats.threat_description: Storage exhaustion via unbounded file uploads or decompression bombs, consuming server disk and memory capacity.
threats.attack_preconditions: Attacker uploads massive files or nested compression archives without upload limits.
threats.security_impact: Server Storage Repository (DS1) exhaustion, preventing all legitimate file uploads.
threats.architecture_evidence: P2 processes file uploads from Zone A into DS1. Lack of quotas or size validation leads to resource exhaustion.
threats.mitigation: Enforce strict per-user storage quotas, maximum upload size caps, and streaming file inspection.
threats.cvss_rationale: Network vector, low complexity, requires low privileges, High Availability impact.
threats.reviewer_validation_basis: Audited against architecture: P2 is the storage gateway into DS1 across TB1.

threats.threat_description: Indirect prompt injection: Uploaded document content contains malicious instructions that hijack the assistant's behavior when processed by P3/P4/EE2.
threats.attack_preconditions: Attacker uploads a document containing adversarial text instructions.
threats.security_impact: Subversion of assistant reasoning, data exfiltration via prompt manipulation, or deceptive summaries.
threats.architecture_evidence: P3 retrieves document content and combines it with user questions into prompt payload DF18 sent to P4/EE2. Explicit requirement 16 addresses indirect prompt injection.
threats.mitigation: Enforce structural prompt isolation (delimiters) separating system instructions from document text, and apply output safety filters.
threats.cvss_rationale: Network vector, low complexity, requires low privileges, Low Confidentiality and Integrity impact.
threats.reviewer_validation_basis: Audited against architecture: P3 aggregates untrusted document content into prompts sent across TB4.

threats.data_flow_ref: DF13: Authorized Context Request / DF16: Authorized Document Retrieval
threats.threat_description: Bypassing authorization workflow: If P3 directly queries DS1 or P2 omits DS2 verification on context retrieval, unauthorized document text is processed by AI assistant.
threats.attack_preconditions: Attacker supplies a target document identifier in an AI question for a file they do not own.
threats.security_impact: Unauthorized exposure of confidential document contents via AI assistant responses.
threats.architecture_evidence: Architecture specifies mandatory authorization path: P3 -> P2 -> DS2 -> DS1 -> P2 -> P3. Bypassing P2/DS2 violates requirement 12 & 13.
threats.mitigation: Strictly enforce the architectural path requiring P2 to verify user authorization against DS2 before returning document context to P3.
threats.cvss_rationale: Network vector, low complexity, requires low privileges, High Confidentiality impact.
threats.reviewer_validation_basis: Audited against architecture: Explicit requirement mandates strict validation through P2/DS2 before P3 context inclusion.

threats.threat_description: Unredacted transmission of sensitive document PII or credentials across TB4 to the third-party External LLM Provider.
threats.attack_preconditions: Authorized document contains sensitive credentials or PII transmitted in full to EE2.
threats.security_impact: Disclosure of confidential user data to third-party external service.
threats.architecture_evidence: P4 transmits DF19 across TB4 to EE2. Requirement 18 mandates that sensitive document information sent to external LLM must be minimized.
threats.mitigation: Apply context minimization, PII redaction, and DLP scanning on document text prior to transmitting prompt payloads.
threats.cvss_rationale: Network vector, low complexity, requires low privileges, High Confidentiality impact.
threats.reviewer_validation_basis: Audited against architecture: P4 sends full prompt payload across external boundary TB4.

threats.data_flow_ref: DF10: Retrieved File / DF23: Answer Display
threats.owasp_ml_sec_top_10_2023: ML06: AI Supply Chain & Output Integrity
threats.threat_description: Stored XSS via downloaded files or rendered AI answers: malicious scripts in uploaded documents or generated text execute in victim browser context.
threats.attack_preconditions: Attacker uploads a file containing active HTML/script content or elicits malicious script in AI output.
threats.security_impact: Client session hijacking, credential theft, and unauthorized browser actions.
threats.architecture_evidence: P1 presents retrieved files (DF10) and answers (DF23) to EE1. Requirement 11 specifies that retrieved files must not be treated as safe active content.
threats.mitigation: Set `Content-Disposition: attachment` on file downloads, sanitize rendered AI text using DOMPurify, and enforce strict CSP.
threats.cvss_rationale: Network vector, low complexity, requires low privileges and user interaction, High C & I impact.
threats.reviewer_validation_basis: Audited against architecture: P1 renders content directly to the user browser across TB1.

threats.data_flow_ref: DF6: Authorization Verification Request / DF14: Authorization Verification
threats.threat_description: Database lockup or availability failure in DS2 causes all authorization checks to fail closed, resulting in complete denial of service for file access and AI assistance.
threats.attack_preconditions: Database connection saturation or high locking queries on DS2.
threats.security_impact: System-wide unavailability of file operations and AI assistant functionality.
threats.architecture_evidence: DS2 is the authoritative source for permissions. Requirement 10 dictates that authorization failure or unavailability must fail closed.
threats.mitigation: Configure connection pooling, query performance indexes, read-replicas, and optimized authorization query caching.
threats.cvss_rationale: Network vector, low complexity, no privileges required, High Availability impact.
threats.reviewer_validation_basis: Audited against architecture: Fail-closed requirement on DS2 causes complete denial of service if DS2 fails.
